Name: Bathhouse Hot Spring - Continued
Author: Sandman53
Description:
This is a re-implementation of the original mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/558]Bathhouse Hotspring
[/url]﻿
I was running into a small compatibility issue with Ridgeside Village and decided the best way to modify the bathhouse and make it compatible with recolors was to not mess with the original tilesheet. This moves all of the new objects to a new tilesheet, and all bathhouse maps are updated accordingly. I've also added an animated version of the candle floating in water because I thought it looked cooler. A handful of other minor issues were fixed too.

I've also included a running water sound if you want to replace the fan-like sound of the bathhouse with something that meshes a bit more with the hot spring vibe.

Recolors and the new music can be enabled in the config, or GMCM.

I've included recolors for:
[list]
[*]Vibrant Pastoral
[*]Earthy
[*]Starblue (Unofficial)
[/list]
